data.description: Operator report 2026-10-14 (live demo at http://localhost:5173 via make up): changing pages reloads the whole site; only the results region should update. Expected: header, filter bar and layout stay mounted and visually stable; only the result list (and pager/summary) update. Root cause and fix to be determined in planning.
data.title: Pagination reloads the whole page instead of only the results region

data.body: Operator ruling 2026-10-14 (diagnosis + decision). Diagnosis: no document reload (a window marker survives the click; Pager uses buttons + history.pushState). What reads as 'the whole site reloading' is the BRANDING 5.9 loading treatment applied to page changes: Search button disables (grey), the 2px loading line runs under the filter bar, StatusLine flips to 'Loading' while 'Page N of M' stays stale, then all of it flips back; with a local API that is a whole-page flash. RULING (quiet swap): a page change touches nothing outside the results. Search stays enabled, no loading line, the status line keeps its count/order text ('12 results · newest first'), 'Page N of M' and the pager's current page update immediately to the requested page, and the list swaps in place when the page arrives; main keeps aria-busy for screen readers. Searches started from the filter bar (Search, Enter, Clear, Try again) keep today's full loading treatment. Contract change: amend BRANDING.md 5.9 Loading row (+ 5.6 status line / 5.8 'Search is disabled while loading' wording as needed) and SPEC 7.5/7.6 in-branch at ruling time.

Orchestrator decision (Moderate autonomy): planner open question 1 resolved as option A. A Search/Enter/Clear that changes only the page writes the same URL as a pager click, so it gets the quiet swap: the loading treatment follows what changed in the URL, no stored 'origin' flag. Open question 2 (republish docs/branding-demo.html to the BRANDING section 9 artifact + owner review) is done by the orchestrator after merge with the operator's go-ahead; the implementer edits docs/branding-demo.html locally only.

BC-25 browser validation (agent:opus-5.5-validator), branch feat/BC-25-quiet-pagination @ 400017d. Verdict: PASS.

Setup
- Worktree Vite on :5174 (VITE_API_PROXY_TARGET=http://localhost:8080), proxied to the operator's live API on :8080 (/api/cities returned 6 cities). Default search: 12 results, 2 pages of 10.
- Own c11 browser panel (panel:44, WKWebView). Installed in the page: window.__marker = 1; the plan section 12 fetch delay (2000 ms, /api/listings/search only, aborts pass through); a DOM probe (Search disabled, [role=progressbar], LoadingLine track class/role, status halves, pager aria-current, main aria-busy, cards and ranks, focus); a MutationObserver that tags every DOM write by region (header, filter bar, loading line, status, main, pager); and identity tags on the header and form nodes to detect a remount.
- Each "mid-flight" read below was taken after the click and before the 2 s delay ran out (the fetch log timestamps confirm this). Screenshots taken in the same window.

Checks (observed values)
1. Pager click Page 2 from a settled page 1 (no budget). Mid-flight at +482 ms: url /?page=2; Search disabled=false; no progressbar; LoadingLine track `_track_pu83o_8`, aria-hidden=true, no role, transparent, 0 children (inactive); status ["12 results · newest first", "Page 2 of 2"]; pager aria-current = Page 2; main aria-busy="true"; page-1 list still shown (10 cards, No. 1..No. 10, first "55 Elm Ct"); focus on #results-heading. Screenshot bc25-val-1-page2-midflight.png shows an oxblood Search, no line, the count text, Page 2 of 2, and the page-1 cards.
   Settled: 2 cards, No. 11..No. 12 ("300 Cedar Blvd"), aria-busy="false", marker 1, header and form are the same DOM nodes (bc25-val-2-page2-settled.png).
   DOM writes during the whole change: status characterData x1 (right half only), main aria-busy x2, main childList (list swap), pager aria-current/disabled. No writes in the header or the loading line, and no `disabled` write in the filter bar. The only filter-bar writes are React's controlled-input `name`/`type` re-assignments, and their old and new values are equal (null/""/null, text/text). They are invisible no-ops from the parent re-render, not part of this change.
2. Browser Back from page 2 to page 1, delay on. Mid-flight: url /; Search enabled; no progressbar; status ["12 results · newest first", "Page 1 of 2"]; aria-current Page 1; aria-busy="true"; page-2 list (No. 11..No. 12) kept. Settled: No. 1..No. 10, aria-busy false, marker 1 (bc25-val-3-back-midflight.png, bc25-val-4-back-settled.png). Same DOM write profile as check 1.
3. Filter search: City=Vienna, Search. Mid-flight: url /?city=Vienna; status ["Loading", "Page 1 of 2"]; Search disabled=true; progressbar present; track gains `_active_pu83o_8`, role=progressbar, background rgb(217,215,208) (line), 1 segment; aria-busy="true"; previous 10 cards kept. Settled: ["2 results · newest first", "Page 1 of 1"], 2 cards, Search enabled (bc25-val-5-filter-midflight.png, bc25-val-6-filter-settled.png). Clear from /?city=Vienna also got the full treatment: Loading, progressbar, Search disabled (bc25-val-7-clear-midflight-a/b.png).
4. M1: a pager click during a filter search. From default page 2, Target budget $450,000 + Search: url /?targetBudget=450000; ["Loading", "Page 2 of 2"]; Search disabled; progressbar; the page-2 list kept (this is the T14 case). Then click Page 2 mid-flight: url /?targetBudget=450000&page=2; the first request is aborted; still ["Loading", "Page 2 of 2"], Search disabled, progressbar on, aria-current Page 2. A second read about 0.8 s later shows the same. Settled: ["12 results · ranked for $450,000", "Page 2 of 2"], No. 11..No. 12 (bc25-val-8-m1-pager-during-search.png, bc25-val-9-m1-settled.png).
5. Option A: on settled /?targetBudget=450000&page=2, Search with unchanged filters. Mid-flight: url /?targetBudget=450000; ["12 results · ranked for $450,000", "Page 1 of 2"]; Search enabled; no progressbar; aria-busy true; page-2 cards kept. Settled: No. 1..No. 10 (bc25-val-10-optionA-midflight.png).
6. AC 9: Page 2 (quiet: Search enabled, "Page 2 of 2"), then City=Vienna + Search mid-flight. The page-2 request is aborted; ["Loading", "Page 1 of 2"], Search disabled, progressbar on. Settled: Vienna, 2 results, ranked. Waited 2.5 s more and the late page-2 response never appeared (bc25-val-11-search-interrupts-page.png).
7. AC 8: one simulated 500 on a page change (page-level fetch wrapper). While loading it was quiet (Search enabled, "Page 2 of 2"). Then the error view "Couldn't load results. / Try again", status ["", ""], no pager, console.error called once (bc25-val-12-page-change-failed.png). Try again mid-flight: ["Loading", ""], Search disabled, progressbar on, error view still shown (bc25-val-13-try-again-midflight.png). Settled: page 2, No. 11..No. 12.
8. Back or forward to different filters: from /?city=Reston, Back to / gave Loading, progressbar, Search disabled, aria-busy true. Forward to /?city=Reston gave the same (bc25-val-15-forward-to-other-filters-midflight.png). The marker survived.
9. First load: a fresh navigation to /?targetBudget=450000&page=2 with the delay as an init script gave ["Loading", ""], progressbar, Search disabled, aria-busy true, no cards and no pager (bc25-val-16-first-load-midflight.png). Settled on ranked page 2.
10. No delay: Page 1, 2, 1, 2, 1 in a row. A MutationObserver checked after every DOM write: the card count never dropped below 2, so there was no blank frame; no progressbar ever appeared; Search was never disabled; the status left text was only "12 results · newest first"; header and form are the same nodes; marker 1. Every settle was correct (No. 1..10 or No. 11..12). Screenshot bc25-val-14-nodelay-after-clicks.png.
11. window.__marker === 1 throughout checks 1-8 (no document reload). It was reset only by the deliberate fresh navigation in check 9.

Optional step 8 (motion): checked as computed styles only. reduced-motion=false; the segment is 250 px of a 625 px track (40%), 2 px high, oxblood rgb(122,31,43), animation `_slide_pu83o_1` 1.2s infinite, playState running. The motion itself was not seen: the validation panel was a background panel (document.hidden=true), so WebKit froze the animation timeline (currentTime 0). Selecting it would have changed the operator's visible panel. This is unchanged code (LoadingLine and its CSS are not in the diff).

AC verdicts
- AC1 PASS (checks 1, 10). AC2 PASS (check 1 no budget; check 5 and 6 ranked). AC3 PASS (checks 1, 2). AC4 PASS (checks 1, 10: no blank frame, ranks continue No. 11). AC5 PASS (aria-busy true then false; focus on #results-heading after a pager click). AC6 PASS (check 2).
- AC7 PASS (checks 3, 4 incl. M1, 7 Try again, 8, 9). AC8 PASS (check 7). AC9 PASS (check 6).
- AC10-AC14 are code, test and doc criteria, covered by the review artifact and not re-run here. The browser behavior is consistent with them.
- Overall: PASS. No implementation-level or plan-level rework needed.
